title: Smoky Shish Taouk
description: A flavorful Egyptian-inspired chicken kebab recipe with smoky spices.
instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together smoky paprika, garlic powder, salt, and black pepper.
Add chicken to the bowl and toss to coat with the spice mixture.
Cover the bowl with plastic wrap and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes or up to 2 hours.
Thread chicken onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
Brush skewers with olive oil and season with salt.
Grill skewers for 8-10 minutes, turning occasionally, or until chicken is cooked through.
Transfer skewers to a plate and brush with lemon juice.
Garnish with chopped parsley and serve hot.
